title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje ne Don Bosko
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 per shitje prane shkolles Qazim Turdiu ne zonen Don Bosco ne Tirane.
Pozicionohet ne katin e 10 por jo te fundit te nje pallati me ashensor.
Me nje siperfaqe totale prej 60m² neto organizohet ne nje sallon me kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Orientimi eshte jugperendim, duke mundesuar drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Aktualisht i dhene me qira ne vlere 450euro ne muaj.
Mundesi e mire per blerje me kredi!
Per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Don Bosco
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale near the Qazim Turdiu school in the Don Bosco area in Tirana. It is located on the 10th but not the last floor of a building with an elevator. With a total area of ​​60m² net, it is organized in a living room with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. Orientation is southwest, allowing natural light throughout the day. They are currently rented for 450 euros per month. Good opportunity to buy with credit! For a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me!
